scripts.ext:pack: npm run ext:build && cd extension/dist && zip -r ../dropimg-extension.zip . && echo Packed extension/dropimg-extension.zip
scripts.predev: npm run generate:pages && npm run generate:site-assets
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:pages && npm run generate:site-assets
scripts.build:staging: npm run generate:pages && npm run generate:site-assets && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vite build
scripts.build:production: npm run generate:pages && npm run generate:site-assets && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vite build
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply dropimg-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply dropimg --remote --env production
